quarterly_data.signal: Supply agreement (release): Prysmian and Aurubis signed a long-term agreement for the supply of copper wire rod, the largest agreement between the two companies, deepening a partnership of more than 30 years; Aurubis supplies from four copper rod plants across Europe, with copper wire rod of approximately 36% recycled material content. COO Alberto Boffelli: Prysmian is 'the world's largest buyer of copper wire rod'.
